title: DecisionView
description: Product-facing composition of the canonical DecisionRecord plus its GenLayer transaction lifecycle, introduced per external A0 review finding A0-003. This type exists so the frontend can show both facts together without the canonical protocol DecisionRecord itself being contaminated with transaction lifecycle state. `record` and `transaction` remain independently meaningful: `record.decisionStage`/`record.outcome` are Reclose application semantics; `transaction.rawStatus`/`transaction.rawResult` are GenLayer protocol transaction facts (CLAUDE.md Section 9 - never collapsed into one field).
